articles.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
articles.snippet: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
articles.snippet: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

articles.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
articles.snippet: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

articles.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
articles.snippet: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

articles.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
articles.snippet: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.
